coverage_claim: Source resolution for one model release from the issue's three URLs plus a check of the developer's GitHub and Hugging Face accounts. Not a literature search; no claim about third-party evaluations.
decision: Zenodo PDF (version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24157116) taken as the primary, hashable artifact; the web report, announcement and Figure 6 page recorded as companion sources. Ladon registered at family level with nine adaptation configurations; 101 printed figure values extracted as results, 32 claims; ClinBench registered as a discovered benchmark with no results.
excluded: LinkedIn announcement by Jonathan Hsu (linked in issue #247): a social post, not a primary source; not retrieved.
gaps: No model weights, code or model licence found on the report, Zenodo, GitHub (blankbio, 0 public repos) or Hugging Face (BlankBio, 0 models) on 2026-11-15; access unresolved, contact provider.
Per-trial values, p-values and confidence intervals shown only on hover or in collapsed data tables of the web figures were not stored.
ClinBench task list and scores not published; Figures 20 and 21 are images.
Source of the clinical trial RNA-seq and outcome data not stated in the report.
No independent evaluation of Ladon was searched for; the model was released three days before the cutoff.
